before.too-few: Drawing names needs {count, plural, one {# more person} other {# more people}}.
before.confirm-description: Everyone gets their giftee right away. People who join later are slotted in.

lock-in.too-few: Locking in needs {count, plural, one {# more person} other {# more people}}.
lock-in.confirm-description: Everyone who's in brings one gift to gift day. People who join later are in too.
lock-in.confirm-description-conspiracy: Everyone who's in gets one gift from all the others on gift day. People who join later are in too.
lock-in.wait: Nothing to do until {organizer} locks it in. Then bring one wrapped gift to gift day.
lock-in.wait-conspiracy: Plan everyone's gift with the others on the Boards tab. {organizer} locks it in before gift day.
lock-in.locked-body: Bring one wrapped gift to gift day. On gift day Givto picks who goes next: open a new gift, or steal one that's already open.
lock-in.locked-body-conspiracy: Keep planning on the boards. On gift day everyone unwraps one gift, from all of us.
